title: Zorg.Pdf document
description: A PDF document for Zorg.Pdf: a title, page settings, optional header and footer, styles, and blocks that flow down the pages. Text is always literal (no template syntax). Lengths are numbers of points or strings with a unit ("12pt", "5mm", "2cm", "0.5in"). Data that changes per render, such as table rows and images, can be named as a slot ({"$data": "name"}) and supplied when rendering. Unknown properties are errors.

title.description: The title. Viewers show it in place of the file name; PDF/UA requires one.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag of the text. Screen readers pick their voice from it.

header.description: Content at the top of every page.

footer.description: Content at the bottom of every page.

watermark.description: Text or an image across every page, such as DRAFT.

numbering.description: How pages are numbered until the first section break.

outlineLevels.description: Headings of level 1 to this one become the viewer's bookmarks; 0 for none.

length.description: A distance: a number of points (1/72 inch), or a string with a unit.

thickness.description: Space on four sides: one length for all, or each side.

pageSize.description: A paper size in portrait: a name, or width and height.

pageSettings.description: Size, orientation and margins of every page.

textStyle.description: How text looks. Unset properties come from the style underneath (block, named style, then body).

fontFamily.description: A font family name from the render's font collection.

lineHeight.description: Line height as a multiple of the font size.

language.description: The text's language as a BCP 47 tag ("de", "nb-NO") when it differs from the document's; screen readers switch voice for it.

styleSheet.description: Named styles, added to and overriding the built-in ones: body, heading1 to heading6, tableHeader, tableCell, header, footer, watermark.

inline.description: A piece of text: a plain string, a styled run, a value bound from the model, a line break, a page number field, or a link.

bind.description: A value from the model: a path such as customer.name or lines.0.amount; inside a repeat, @index and @number give the position.

format.description: A .NET format string for numbers and dates, such as N2 or yyyy-MM-dd, in the document's language.

field.description: Filled in when the page is drawn.

oneOf.description: Text that opens a web page, starts an e-mail, or jumps to a block with that id.

link.description: https://..., http://..., mailto:..., or # and a block's id.

description.description: What the link does, for screen readers, when its text doesn't say it.

inlines.description: Text as an array of inlines, such as ["Page ", {"field": "pageNumber"}].

slot.description: A value supplied when rendering, by name.

id.description: A name links and viewers can jump to (file.pdf#name): letters, digits, -, _, . and :, unique in the document.

block.description: Something that flows down the page. The "type" property says which.

sectionBreak.description: Starts a new page and a new page numbering from there on: the viewer's page labels, page number fields and table of contents numbers.

startAt.description: The number of the section's first page; by default 1 when the numbering changes, else the count continues.

prefix.description: Text before each page number, such as A-.

tableOfContents.description: One entry per top-level heading of levels 1 to maxLevel, indented by level, with dot leaders and page numbers filled in when the document is finished. Each entry links to its heading. Styles toc1 to toc6.

title.description: A heading above the entries, such as Contents.

leaders.description: Dots from each entry to its page number.

textBox.description: Paragraphs at a fixed place on the page, measured from the paper's top-left corner, such as a letter's address for a window envelope. Takes no room in the flow. Give a preset, or x, y, width and height (which override a preset).

content.description: Paragraphs, or repeat and when blocks that make them.

preset.description: din5008A: 85 x 45 mm at 20 mm from the left and 27 mm from the top; din5008B: the same at 45 mm from the top. Text starts 5 mm in.

borderWidth.description: Default 0.5 pt when there's a border colour.

overflow.description: Text that doesn't fit: shrinkToFit (the default) makes it smaller down to minSize, then cuts whole lines; clip cuts whole lines; visible draws past the box.

minSize.description: The smallest body text size shrinkToFit uses. Default 6 pt.

heading.description: A heading, tagged H1 to H6.

paragraph.description: Text that wraps to the width of the page.

watermark.description: Text or an image across every page, turned and see-through. Screen readers skip it. Set text or image.

text.description: One line of text, in the watermark style.

size.description: Font size of text, or width of an image. Default: text spans most of the page diagonally, an image half the page width.

color.description: Colour of text. Default mid grey.

repeat.description: Content repeated for each item of an array in the model. Inside it, bindings look in the item first.

items.description: The path of an array in the model.

when.description: Content shown only when a model value is set (not missing, null, false, 0, empty text or an empty array), or with not: true only when it isn't.

test.description: The path of a value in the model.

list.description: A bulleted or numbered list, tagged for screen readers. Items hold paragraphs and nested lists.

style.description: A named style for the items' text.

marker.description: What marks each item. Nested bullet lists use other bullet shapes.

start.description: The number of the first item.

indent.description: How far items are indented; the marker sits in this space. Default 18pt.

listItem.description: A list item: a string for one paragraph, or blocks (paragraphs and nested lists).

columnWidth.description: A share of the free width ("*", "2*") or a fixed length.

header.description: The header text, tagged as a column header.

cell.description: A cell: a string, inlines with an alignment and spans, or one binding ({ "bind": "amount", "format": "N2" }).

bind.description: The path of a value in the template model.

format.description: A .NET format string for numbers and dates, in the document's language.

columnSpan.description: How many columns the cell covers.

rowSpan.description: How many rows the cell covers. Rows joined by a span stay on one page.

table.description: A table with a header row of column titles that repeats on each page. A row taller than a page splits across pages; other rows don't.

rows.description: Rows in the document (each one cell per column), a slot filled when rendering, or one row per item of a model array.

oneOf.description: One row per element of the array at "repeat" in the model; inside, bindings name the element's fields.

repeat.description: The path of an array in the model.

tableStyle.description: How a table is drawn, beyond its text styles (tableHeader, tableCell). Unset properties keep the default: header fill #E6E6E6, rules #666666 at 0.3 pt, 3 pt padding.

ruleWidth.description: Width of the rule under each row; 0 draws none.

imageSource.description: The image file as base64, or a slot filled when rendering. Documents never name files.

image.description: A JPEG or PNG picture. Needs alt text unless decorative.

alt.description: What the image shows, for screen readers.

decorative.description: The image adds nothing to the text; screen readers skip it.
